name: British Postcodes
description: The postcode in each of Royal Mail's six formats and GIR 0AA, written with or without its space and in any case, standing on its own line, before the post town or after it; a postcode the grammar refuses; BFPO; the Crown Dependencies, which share the format but are not in the United Kingdom; and the nation each postcode delivers to, across the borders of Wales and of Scotland. Original cases written for this corpus from Royal Mail's addressing rules, described in our own words; the nations are Code-Point Open's (OGL v3).
